speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) what is the current percentage of workers in the online food delivery industry who are foreigners; (b) how do the foreigners qualify to work in this industry; and (c) whether the Ministry will take steps to ensure that these jobs in the delivery services are restricted to only Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Anyone with information on such illegal workers should report this to MOM.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: The second question is, my residents told me that quite often, they see persons on Malaysia-registered motorcycles delivering food.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, it looks like we need to step up enforcement.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Because they are competing with our Singaporeans who are earning pocket money and those are our jobs.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: We do not need them to come here to moonlight or do things that are illegal.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, I would like to know how many have been caught and, if residents see them delivering food, what can the public do?

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, I cannot give too much details of the cases.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: At the same time, regarding the Member's concerns, we need more people to report.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: If the Member's residents come to know of such cases, please ask them to report to MOM.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: Perhaps the Minister of State can take this opportunity to advertise the telephone number to call.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: The Member can come to our website to find the number to call.
